description: Overview of the GigXchange Index (GX Index), the UK live-music pay index: headline counts, the cities it covers, every published monthly issue (slug, title, url), the latest issue's open datasets (HuggingFace, Kaggle, Zenodo DOI) and the city average-fee league behind the Pint Index. Start here for any GX Index question; use get_rates for fees and get_index_issue for one issue.
name: get_index_summary
title: GX Index overview
